rubrics.justification: The model explicitly stated it could not assess morphology without an image and did not fabricate embryo features. Since no image was available to the model, this is an appropriate and accurate handling of morphology.
It thoroughly integrated age, PCOS, AMH/FSH, oocyte maturity, endometrium, semen parameters, BMI, partner age, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and transfer planning.
The reasoning is structured, internally consistent, and appropriately caveated around the missing morphology and PGT data. Probability estimates are presented as conditional and justified.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: SET at age 34, caution with fresh transfer in PCOS/high responders, luteal support, no bed rest, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Minor uncertainty remains because some implantation percentages are broad and clinic-dependent.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including alcohol cessation, OHSS/fresh-vs-freeze considerations, trigger review for low MII proportion, metabolic optimization, and when to consider further male-factor testing or PGT-A.
